O propósito do EnsinoTec é oferecer um a: EnsinoTec aims to help students review and reinforce what they learned in lower secondary school, particularly as they move on to upper secondary education. The platform organizes accessible learning resources, including summaries, mind maps, educational videos and exercises. It currently focuses on essential mathematics topics. Other lower secondary school subjects are planned for the future, providing support across more areas of knowledge.
O EnsinoTec foi desenvolvido para auxili: EnsinoTec helps students review mathematics in a simple, organized and accessible way. It brings learning resources together so students can easily find study support. Summaries, mind maps, educational videos and exercises offer different ways to review each topic. The platform currently covers lower secondary mathematics, especially for students starting upper secondary school who want to revisit key concepts. Other subjects are planned to expand the learning materials available.
Grupos dos desenvolvedores e os coorient: Development teams and co-supervisors, together with final-project teacher Rodrigo Bruno Kehdy.
